watches.name: OCTONOID 36 Navy Yellow Gold
watches.description: The Navy Yellow Gold Octonoid is designed to stand out. Its vibrant Navy Yellow Gold dial gives the watch a distinctive, iconic presence on the wrist within its 36 mm case. Like the rest of the Octonoid line, it takes a playful approach to watchmaking, using dial artwork to bring a sense of fun to collecting. But it’s not just about aesthetics—this is a day, date and sun/moon indicator complication powered by the Epson VX3H quartz movement, offering quartz precision with the aesthetic of a complication. It’s a confident mix of bold design and genuine watchmaking substance.
